recognize_zh: H&E 切片中大量核碎片（karyorrhectic debris）與凋亡小體，周圍是細胞核呈新月形或扭曲狀的組織球（crescentic histiocytes）及淋巴樣細胞，背景淡粉紅纖維素樣，且看不到嗜中性球，是 Kikuchi 淋巴腺炎的典型特徵。
features: Abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris and apoptotic bodies
Histiocytes with crescentic, twisted or indented nuclei and pale foamy cytoplasm
Admixed plasmacytoid dendritic cells and immunoblast-like larger lymphoid cells
Conspicuous absence of neutrophils and eosinophils
describe_en: Section shows a paracortical-type area with extensive apoptotic and karyorrhectic nuclear debris. Numerous histiocytes with crescentic or twisted nuclei, plasmacytoid dendritic cells and scattered larger activated lymphoid cells are present in a pale fibrinoid background. Neutrophils and eosinophils are notably absent, and no sheets of monotonous atypical cells are seen. Findings are consistent with histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis (Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease); correlation with ANA/anti-dsDNA is recommended to exclude lupus lymphadenitis.

ddx.vs: Morphologically similar but often shows hematoxylin bodies, plasma cells and vascular DNA deposition (Azzopardi phenomenon), and requires serologic correlation.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell or large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Shows sheets of cytologically atypical lymphoid cells with aberrant or clonal T-cell phenotype, whereas Kikuchi has a mixed CD8+ T-cell, histiocyte (MPO+/CD68+) and pDC population.
Contains neutrophils and microabscesses or viral inclusions, whereas Kikuchi necrosis is characteristically devoid of neutrophils.
